## Positive Evidence Summary

- The staged source begins with `LODEPNG_VERSION_STRING = "20160501"`; the binary contains the exact literal at `0x60F4C0` and a data pointer at `0x66D000`.
- Public decode and encode wrappers match source semantics and order. Project code directly calls decode32, decode32_file, and encode32_file.
- The binary has both `LodePNGState` and `lodepng::State` vtable/RTTI families, proving C++ wrapper support.
- Diagnostic strings prove decoder, encoder, ancillary chunks, error text, zlib, disk I/O, and default allocator feature coverage.
- No external zlib import route appears; internal Huffman/deflate/zlib code and the standard tables are present.
- The staged pair is hash-identical to the obtained static source copy.
- The exact source pair therefore explains code, data, vtables, RTTI, strings, tables, and public integration without local patches.
